         app = model._meta.app_label

+    def _get_choices(self):
+        return self._choices
+
+    def _set_choices(self, value):
+        # Convert enum values to their raw values for consistency
+        if isinstance(value, collections.abc.Iterator):
+            value = list(value)
+        if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
+            value = [
+                (item.value if hasattr(item, 'value') else item[0],
+                 item.display if hasattr(item, 'display') else item[1])
+                if isinstance(item, (tuple, list)) and len(item) == 2
+                else (item.value, item.display) if hasattr(item, 'value') and hasattr(item, 'display')
+                else item
+                for item in value
+            ]
+        self._choices = value
+
+    choices = property(_get_choices, _set_choices)
+
     def __repr__(self):
         """Display the module, class, and name of the field."""
         path = '%s.%s' % (self.__class__.__module__, self.__class__.__qualname__)
